selection_rule: Maximize aggregate fallback critical hits subject to no development seed falling below frozen GCN; tie-break by relay hits and shed.
claim_boundary: Validated on five untouched synthetic load scenarios; this is not utility-grid deployment evidence or a worst-case guarantee.

rejected_methods.local_rrf: Destroyed cross-S1 score comparability and regressed all development seeds.
rejected_methods.equal_weight_global_rrf: Valid but lower aggregate development critical hits than weight 0.70.
